items.q: Where will my private driver meet us at Le Havre Cruise Port?
items.a: Your driver waits directly at the exit of your Le Havre cruise ship terminal holding a welcome sign with your name, eliminating taxi queues or shuttle transfers.

items.q: How do you guarantee we return before All-Aboard Time?
items.a: We systematically ask for your ship's all-aboard time when quoting and plan a minimum 60-minute safety margin back to the pier. If a route like Mont-Saint-Michel does not fit your port call, we advise you honestly beforehand.

items.q: Is the price per person or per vehicle?
items.a: Every quotation is per private vehicle for your exclusive group of 1 to 4 guests—never per seat. You never share the car with strangers.

items.q: Can we combine Étretat and Honfleur in one excursion?
items.a: Yes! Étretat + Honfleur (~7h) is our most requested combination because both towns are within 30–35 minutes of Le Havre Cruise Terminal.

items.q: Do you provide guided tours inside monuments and museums?
items.a: We provide private chauffeur-driven transportation with multilingual communication. You explore monuments freely at your own pace; official interior monument guides are not included.

items.q: What if our cruise ship is delayed or skips Le Havre?
items.a: We monitor ship arrivals closely. If your arrival time shifts slightly, we adapt pick-up accordingly. Please review our booking terms regarding weather or port-call cancellations.
